UnitStatement: The docs/ package is a seed governance and decomposition set for agentic development of OpenPipeStress.
OpenPipeStress is a free and open-source, code-neutral piping flexibility and stress-analysis platform.
The central project stance is: Open the mechanics; protect the standards; empower the engineer.

This package is written from the perspective of SOFTWARE_DECOMP, converting product intent and the PRD into a structured, flat package/deliverable decomposition suitable for downstream agent execution.
INIT.md is the Bootstrap document: required reading order and agent startup constraints, maintained only at the repository root.
AGENTS.md is the Agent index: project-specific use of Chirality agent roles.
INTENT.md captures directional intent: why this product exists and what must remain true.
PRD.md captures product requirements: product capabilities, users, non-goals, and release strategy.
DIRECTIVE.md is the founding directive: design philosophy, professional boundary, stop rules, and scope constraints.
TYPES.md defines vocabulary and identity: canonical terms, IDs, statuses, and software/piping domain types.
CONTRACT.md is the invariant catalog: binding project invariants for legal/data boundary, solver, rule packs, reports, and agents.
SPEC.md is the technical specification: architecture, schemas, solver mechanics, GUI, reports, V&V, and agentic execution mechanics.
IP_AND_DATA_BOUNDARY.md is the data/IP policy: public/private data rules, contributor certification, provenance, and quarantine policy.
VALIDATION_STRATEGY.md covers verification and validation: benchmark and release-quality strategy.
_Decomposition/SOFTWARE_DECOMP.md is the working surface: SSOW, objectives, packages, deliverables, scope ledger summary, telemetry, and open issues.
_Registers/ScopeLedger.csv is an authoritative companion register: machine-readable scope-to-package/deliverable mapping.
_Registers/Deliverables.csv is an authoritative companion register: machine-readable deliverable catalog.
_Registers/ContextBudgetQA.csv is an authoritative companion register: context-envelope and sizing audit.
This package is the v0.2 current downstream decomposition basis for agentic preparation and sealed deliverable execution.
This package is not an approved engineering work product, not a legal opinion, and not a claim of code compliance.
Agents start from INIT.md, then follow execution/_Coordination/_COORDINATION.md for authority intake, work selection, execution discipline, validation, and handoff.
Agents use docs/_Decomposition/SOFTWARE_DECOMP.md as the authoritative working surface for packages and deliverables.
Agents use docs/_Registers/*.csv for machine-checkable mappings.
Every deliverable is treated as bounded: no agent may expand scope silently.
Unknown values become TBD; suspected protected data is quarantined and escalated.
Generated outputs remain drafts until a human accepts them at the appropriate gate.
Conversation intent is captured in INTENT.md as a foundational reference for this package.
Product requirements are captured in PRD.md as a foundational reference for this package.
Chirality bootstrap and agent framework examples were supplied by the user as a foundational reference.
M. W. Kellogg, Design of Piping Systems (1956) is used as a historical technical reference for classical piping flexibility analysis.
